ops.text: Any investigation under Subsection 11.3 will be conducted no more than once in any 12 month period, upon at least 30 days' prior written notice to Customer, during business hours, off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, without direct access to Customer's systems, and at IBM's cost unless the investigation reveals an underpayment by Customer exceeding 5%.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have left § 11.3 untouched and added one sentence limiting IBM's investigation right to once per 12 months on 30 days' written notice, during business hours, off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, with no direct access to our systems and at IBM's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%. This is our standard audit position; we can discuss 15 days' notice and a 10% cost-shift threshold as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Add a single sentence in § 11.3 setting frequency, 30 days' notice, business hours, independent auditor, no system access and cost limits on IBM's investigation right

mappings.element: No more than one audit per 12 months.
Audit at Vendor's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%.
No direct access to Customer systems.
